column1: # gate-tools.tsv - the tools a tools/testrunner command unit may ask for
# (scripts/ci/gate-commands.tsv, tools column), pinned by version and sha256
# per architecture. tools/testrunner/bootstrap.sh installs a tool once per
# worker from this row and refuses a tarball whose sha256 differs.
# Columns (tab separated): tool  version  arch  sha256  url
# golangci-lint: the version ci.yml's lint job pins (golangci-lint-action
# node: ci.yml pins only the major (`node-version: '22'`, setup-node takes
#   the newest 22.x); the runner pins the newest 22.x at the time of writing,
#   v22.23.5, with the sha256 from nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.5/SHASUMS256.txt.
# node20, node22, node24: the SDK matrix (lane B4, plan W2-4 / principle 9:
#   sdk/typescript on every Node major its engines field admits that is
#   still tested; scripts/ci/sdk.sh). Official nodejs.org tarballs, the
#   newest release of each major at the time of writing, sha256 from that
#   release's SHASUMS256.txt. node22 pins the same tarball as node but is a
#   row of its own, so moving the web suites to a newer major does not move
# python3.9 .. python3.13: the SDK matrix for sdk/python (requires-python
#   (the builds uv installs): the tarball unpacks to python/, so bootstrap's
#   --strip-components=1 leaves bin/python3 on PATH. The newest patch of each
#   minor at the time of writing; sha256 from uv 0.13.9's
#   download-metadata.json, which uv verifies these same URLs against. 3.9
